user.title: Set up Ambience
user.description: This will create the Ambience integration entry.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

data_description.show_sidebar_panel: When off, Ambience is removed from the sidebar. You can still add the Ambience card to any dashboard.
data_description.enable_ai_tab: Adds an AI tab to the Ambience panel for authoring and fixing scenes with an AI assistant. Off by default while in beta.

missing_entity.title: Ambience: a scene references a missing or disabled entity

action_overlap.title: Ambience: an entity is controlled by multiple groups

missing_workday_sensor.title: Ambience: scenes use a workday item but no workday sensor is configured

missing_weather_entity.title: Ambience: scenes use a weather condition but no weather entity is configured

missing_weather_group.title: Ambience: scenes reference a deleted weather group

missing_period.title: Ambience: scenes reference a deleted time-of-day period

missing_lux_range.title: Ambience: scenes reference a deleted lux range

unexposed_action.title: Ambience: scenes use an action that is no longer exposed

turn_on.name: Turn on
turn_on.description: Turn on the targeted entities, skipping any that are already on. Works across all on/off-capable domains.

turn_off.name: Turn off
turn_off.description: Turn off the targeted entities, skipping any that are already off. Works across all on/off-capable domains.

cover_safe_open.name: Open cover (safe)
cover_safe_open.description: Open the targeted covers, skipping any already fully open (no redundant relay click).

cover_safe_close.name: Close cover (safe)
cover_safe_close.description: Close the targeted covers, skipping any already fully closed (no redundant relay click).

cover_safe_set_position.name: Set cover position (safe)
cover_safe_set_position.description: Set the targeted covers to a position, skipping any already at that position.

cover_safe_set_tilt_position.name: Set cover tilt (safe)
cover_safe_set_tilt_position.description: Set the targeted covers to a tilt position, skipping any already at that tilt.
